storeUrls.title: Store URLs
storeUrls.description: Shopify store homepages, collection URLs or product URLs, e.g. https://www.allbirds.com or https://www.allbirds.com/collections/mens.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Only return products whose title, vendor, product type or tags contain every word in this query (case-insensitive). Applied client-side after fetching each store's catalog — Shopify's public feed has no server-side search, so this still walks the full store (same request cost as without it) but needs no collection URL guessing. Ignored for direct product URLs.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Stop after this many products for each store URL.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Include the product description as plain text.

includeVariants.title: Include variants
includeVariants.description: Include the full variants array (SKU, price, options, availability).

onlyAvailable.title: Only available products
onlyAvailable.description: Skip products where no variant is available.

maxResults.title: Max results (total)
maxResults.description: Overall cap on the number of products across all stores.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Route storefront requests through Apify Proxy. Recommended: some stores rate-limit or geo-gate products.json by IP, and residential/country-specific proxies also return that country's prices and currency. Leave as-is to use automatic Apify Proxy; runs on accounts without proxy access fall back to a direct connection.

detailLevel.title: Detail level
detailLevel.description: "Basic" (default) uses only the store's bulk products.json feed — one request per page of products. "Full" additionally fetches each product's live page and its per-product JSON to read barcodes, inventory counts (inventoryQuantity / totalInventory), SEO title/description and the star-rating summary — none of which the bulk feed carries. The two extra requests run in parallel and are charged as a single event per product. How much stock data exists is a per-store setting; unpublished values come back as null.
enumTitles: Full (+ barcodes, inventory counts, SEO + rating)
